vostride-agent-qa-agent-qa-authoring.description: Use when creating, editing, validating, or running agent-qa tests, suites, or hooks. Prefer agent-qa MCP tools, enforce canonical agent-qa IDs, and use the bundled schema reference to avoid hallucinated config keys or YAML fields.

vostride-agent-qa-agent-qa-debug-fix.description: Use after an agent-qa run has failed and you need to debug, patch, and verify the issue using MCP evidence, logs, artifacts, and local code changes instead of generated fix suggestions.

vostride-agent-qa-agent-qa-knowledge.description: Use when asked what an agent-qa run did, why a step passed or failed, what a run's screenshots, console or network showed, what knowledge agent-qa learned or served, where a knowledge record came from, or which runs exist. Reads runs, evidence and knowledge through the agent-qa MCP tools or the agent-qa CLI with --json, never through .agent-qa files, SQLite or index files.

vostride-agent-qa-agent-qa-result-triage.description: Use when investigating failed agent-qa runs, inspecting artifacts, classifying failures, or comparing recent runs. Prefer agent-qa MCP run/artifact tools and produce evidence-backed triage.
